description: Time view passed to choose_move. Values come from the turn message; elapsed time is measured locally with a monotonic clock from the moment the SDK received turn.

functions.name: remaining_ms
functions.description: Own remaining time at the start of this turn, as sent by the referee; does not decrease while thinking.

functions.name: increment_ms
functions.description: Time added after each own move.

functions.name: elapsed_ms
functions.description: Time spent on this turn so far. The referee's measurement additionally contains transport time, so bots should keep a margin.
